🎬✨ TAMASHA BHOOTS: A Desi Costume Party Like No Other ✨🎬
Hosted by: TAMASHA NIGHTS
🗓️ One unforgettable night. One epic Bollywood Halloween bash.

👻 HALLOWEEN GOES FULL DESI!Forget basic costumes. TAMASHA BHOOTS is where Bollywood meets Bhoot- and the more dramatic, filmy, spooky, or ridiculous you get, the better. 👻🔥
Come dressed as your favorite Bollywood character, a classic bhoot, or a Bollywood Bhoot of your own creation. Think SRK, Madhuri, Ranveer, Deepika, Kareena… or turn your favorite Bollywood icon into their supernatural alter ego. 🧛🏽‍♀️🎬
Whether you’re serving Bollywood superstar, filmi villain, desi ghost, haunted heroine, spooky hero, or full-on Bollywood Bhoot- this is your night to bring the character to life.
Because at TAMASHA, we don’t just party… we make a scene. 🎭👻
💥 Bollywood music all night long- from iconic classics and party anthems to today’s biggest Desi hits.
